fact: The health ministry's Annuaire statistique sanitaire 2021-2023, issued July 2025, compiles health facility reports (DHIS2 annual reports from 52 health districts and hospitals) and says the ministry has produced a yearbook every year since 2012, this being a continuation of previous editions.
title: Annuaire statistique sanitaire 2021-2023
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population, Direction des études et de la planification
